comment: LOKA Atlas capability catalog — single source of truth for the wizard (display), the API (validation, cost gate) and the Python builder (recipe dispatch). tiers: which region tiers can use a layer ('global' = any country, 'india' = ISO3 IND). cost: 'free' builds run immediately; 'approval' needs an admin OK (large source downloads). Layer stanzas themselves live in the recipes, ported from the proven deoria-bioregion manifest styling.

tiers.global: Baseline — open worldwide sources (geoBoundaries, OSM, ESA WorldCover)
tiers.india: Enhanced — adds LGD boundaries and WRIS/NDEM water & flood layers

layers.label: Admin boundaries
layers.info: The units you picked (districts / admin-2), with labels and click-for-details.

attribution.india: Local Government Directory via Bharatlas, CC0

layers.label: Blocks / sub-divisions
layers.info: One level below your picked units — blocks in India.

attribution.india: Local Government Directory via Bharatlas, CC0

layers.label: Rivers & waterways
layers.info: Rivers and canals from OpenStreetMap for your region.

layers.label: Rivers & canals
layers.info: Rivers, streams and irrigation canals from India-WRIS.

layers.label: Wetlands & water bodies
layers.info: Lakes, ponds, ox-bows and riverine wetlands.

layers.label: River sub-basins
layers.info: Hydrological sub-basin boundaries over your region.

layers.label: Floodplain (observed inundation)
layers.info: Areas flooded at least once 1998–2022, from ISRO's NDEM satellite record. Heavy source data — needs a quick approval.

attribution.india: NRSC / ISRO NDEM via Bharatlas, CC0

layers.label: Land use / land cover
layers.info: ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m) as a toggleable overlay, clipped to your region.

layers.label: Urban / built-up areas
layers.info: Town and city footprints derived from the WorldCover built-up class.

layers.label: Place names
layers.info: Town, village and river names on the basemap — on by default, switchable off in the layer widget.

layers.label: Terrain & elevation
layers.info: Shaded relief coloured by elevation — the lie of the land, from the Copernicus 30 m global DEM.

attribution.global: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (© DLR/Airbus, ESA), free & open

layers.label: Annual rainfall
layers.info: Total rainfall for the latest full year, from CHIRPS satellite-gauge data (~5 km).

attribution.global: CHIRPS v2.0 (UCSB Climate Hazards Center), public domain

layers.label: Forest cover & loss
layers.info: Tree cover in 2000 and forest lost since, from Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change (30 m).

attribution.global: Hansen/UMD/Google/USGS/NASA Global Forest Change v1.12, CC-BY 4.0

layers.label: Surface water
layers.info: How often each place held water 1984–2021 — permanent vs seasonal, from JRC Global Surface Water (30 m).

attribution.global: EC JRC / Google Global Surface Water, free & open

layers.label: Soil organic carbon
layers.info: Topsoil organic carbon (0–5 cm), a soil-health proxy, from ISRIC SoilGrids (250 m).

layers.label: Travel time to healthcare
layers.info: Estimated motorized travel time to the nearest health facility — an access-equity layer (Malaria Atlas Project, ~1 km).

layers.label: Health facilities
layers.info: Hospitals, clinics and pharmacies mapped in OpenStreetMap (Humanitarian OSM Team export).

attribution.global: OpenStreetMap contributors via HOT / HDX, ODbL

layers.label: Schools & colleges
layers.info: Schools, colleges and kindergartens mapped in OpenStreetMap (Humanitarian OSM Team export).

attribution.global: OpenStreetMap contributors via HOT / HDX, ODbL

layers.label: Lok Sabha constituencies
layers.info: Parliamentary (Lok Sabha) constituency boundaries with reservation status, 2019 delimitation.

layers.label: Institutional births (NFHS-5)
layers.info: Share of births in a health facility, by district (NFHS-5, 2019–21). Joined to your districts.

attribution.india: NFHS-5 (IIPS / MoHFW); district table via jvargh7

layers.label: Women's literacy (NFHS-5)
layers.info: Share of women 15–49 who are literate, by district (NFHS-5, 2019–21).

attribution.india: NFHS-5 (IIPS / MoHFW); district table via jvargh7

layers.label: Clean cooking fuel (NFHS-5)
layers.info: Households cooking with clean fuel, by district (NFHS-5, 2019–21) — an energy-poverty indicator.

attribution.india: NFHS-5 (IIPS / MoHFW); district table via jvargh7

layers.label: Child stunting (NFHS-5)
layers.info: Children under 5 who are stunted (low height-for-age), by district (NFHS-5, 2019–21). Lower is better.

attribution.india: NFHS-5 (IIPS / MoHFW); district table via jvargh7

layers.label: Buildings
layers.info: Building footprints from OpenStreetMap, streamed live from the global Protomaps tiles — zoom in to see them. No build time.

layers.label: Roads & streets
layers.info: The road and street network from OpenStreetMap, streamed live from the global Protomaps tiles. No build time.
